notes:
Big update!
- FIXED: keychains now show up when you equip them. They hang off the left side of the gun, where you can see them in first person and in the Gunsmith, instead of hiding inside or behind the gun
- REAL gun sounds: every gun now has a sharp crack, a deep thump and its own bolt clatter, echoes off the arena walls outdoors and rings short in the hotel halls, and far-off shots sound muffled, come from the direction they were fired and arrive a moment late. Silenced guns like the AS VAL go quiet and mechanical, bolt-action snipers and the Model 870 work the bolt or pump after each shot
- REAL people on Ultra/Cinematic: soldiers and zombies are now rigged, photo-textured human models (3 soldiers, 4 zombified hotel guests), with a lighter far-away version so frame rate stays the same
- REAL scanned textures on Ultra/Cinematic: 20 photo-scanned surfaces (sand, sandstone, concrete, brick, wood, metal, grass, snow, marble, carpet, wallpaper and more) with real bumps and roughness on every map and in the hotel
- Outdoor maps are lit by a real photographed sky (HDRI) in daytime
- NEW: Controller support (Xbox, PlayStation and other gamepads): play and use every menu with a controller, with vibration, look speed and invert look settings
- 120 FPS mode: Target frame rate setting (Auto matches your screen, up to 240), dynamic resolution keeps it smooth, optional FPS counter
- More realistic graphics on Ultra/Cinematic: ambient occlusion adds soft contact shadows where people, objects and walls meet
- NEW: Player levels 1-55: earn XP from kills, assists, medals, objectives and wins, with level-up popups and your level on the scoreboard
- Level up to unlock guns, and level up each gun to unlock its attachments (guns you already used stay unlocked)
- Hip fire now spreads a little when you are not aimed in (more while moving or spraying)
- Parties are back in the desktop app
- NEW MODE: Search and Destroy: one life per round, plant or defuse the bomb at A or B (offline vs bots, and online)
- Realistic graphics on Ultra/Cinematic: proper tone mapping, physically based materials with surface detail, soft clouds and sun glow, modern HUD font
- Medals: Double Kill up to Kill Chain, Bloodthirsty to Nuclear streaks, First Blood, Headshot, Longshot, Payback, Ace and more, listed after each match
- Killcam: watch who got you, then click to respawn (spectate teammates in Search and Destroy)
- Banners: 22 calling cards (free, Shop, achievements) shown to the players you eliminate, plus PAYBACK kills
- NEW MAP: Grand Colosseum, a huge long arena packed with cover (also in online TDM and FFA)
- Phone layout fixed, online matches are now 5v5 to 100, set your own score (up to 1000) offline
- Bigger maps, plus two new ones: Farmstead and Downtown
- Play on phones and tablets (touch controls)
- 10 new guns incl. the Kar98k, new grenades and tacticals, sniper scopes
- 7 new scorestreaks, up to the Tactical Nuke
- Emotes, tracer rounds, keychains, new camos, codes, achievement rewards
- Parties, matchmaking, private matches and voice chat
- More realistic soldiers, zombies, guns and furniture
